breaking.change: `downloads.later.modules` is new: the single-threaded page's split engine modules (`modules/`) the game does not reference, each fetched on its first call (one variant: the lanes page's own are not added). `downloads.boot.single.engine` and `downloads.boot.lanes.engine` now count, beside the engine module, the split modules the game references (og-build.json `modules.referenced`), which the page puts in place before its first tick. Only a build that carries its modules (`--modules local`, or an engine built in a checkout) counts them: a CDN build's modules are no file of it, so its `later.modules` is zero and its boot counts none.
breaking.fix: Read the referenced modules' bytes in `boot.<page>.engine` and the others' in `later.modules`; for a CDN build, take module sizes from the engine version's `modules.json`.

breaking.change: `basis/` (the Basis transcoder) is left out of a publish build's `dist/` unless its cooked bundle holds a texture, texture array or lightmap, or it names a content base or opens a bundle at run time (og.load.bundle). `av1/` (the AV1 fallback decoder and its Worker) is left out of any build without a video that neither references the `video` module, names a content base nor opens a bundle at run time. The page's configuration then says `noBasis` or `noAv1` and fetches neither.
breaking.fix: Expect `basis/` and `av1/` only in a build that can use them; a host that copies or serves them by fixed path checks that they exist.

added.summary: A page fetches its split engine modules asynchronously (the referenced ones beside the primary, and a prefetch as content is prepared) with Subresource Integrity: each module's SHA-256 from the engine's `modules.json` (a CDN build) or of the copied file (`--modules local`), so the browser refuses other bytes. A module loaded synchronously by a call that arrived first, and a lanes pool Worker's own fetch, are not checked.

fixed.summary: Splits `shape`, `tilemap`, `timeline`, `net`, `shared`, `smaa`, and per-module generated wire types out of the primary WASM, keeping in the primary what every page calls (the rooms' and og.shared's host side, flipbook loading), so a game that uses none of them loads none; precaches every split module the build carries for the page's variant, and a CDN build's referenced ones under their CDN URL (the rest cached on their first fetch); slims embedded `bindings.json` and drops `SourceMap` from publish JS bundles; removes leaked `.graph.json` files from `dist/`; resolves `destruction` to `destruction2d` or `destruction3d` by the og.destruction call a game makes (a `…2d` call is destruction2d's), else by the project's profile; and no longer reads a regular expression literal in game code as a string or comment when finding the modules it references.
